summary: You present a strong, well-structured preliminary report. Your mission concept clearly identifies users and needs, and your project plan is robust with a Gantt chart, contingencies and sources. Preliminary orbit/swath work is sound and on track. To strengthen, tighten citation-to-claim links in the rationale and document the assumptions behind your swath and reef-width figures.
next_steps: In Mission Concept & Rationale, replace or supplement [6] with a BoM SST source and replace [4] with a satellite-resolution reference or show your derivation of the 10 m GSD requirement.
In Preliminary Progress, state the detector/optics basis for the 6,000 across-track pixels in the swath calculation and cite a source for the 'about 250 km wide' reef figure.

In Project Plan, add explicit milestones and map each information source to the task it supports; in Preliminary Progress, include STK outputs or a short table to document the scenario beyond the period check.

criteria.C1: Your Mission Concept & Rationale gives a clear goal, objectives and preliminary requirements, with explicit users (AIMS, GBRMPA, CSIRO/researchers, BoM) and strong rationale. To secure the top of Accomplished, align citations with claims: [6] should support BoM SST, and the 10 m GSD should be tied to a satellite-resolution source or derivation rather than the airborne-mapping news article [4].
criteria.C2: Your Project Plan is robust: the Gantt chart, task descriptions, software choice and information sources are present, and the sequence follows the mission requirements. Contingencies and float are meaningful. To strengthen within Accomplished, add explicit milestones and a source-to-task mapping so each source's role is clear.
criteria.C3: Your Preliminary Progress includes good hand calculations (period, orbits/day, SSO inclination, ground-track shift, swath) and interpretation of coverage, and the STK period check shows you are on track. To strengthen, document the STK scenario with outputs and justify the 6,000-pixel assumption; cite the 'about 250 km wide' reef figure.
criteria.C4: Your report is well structured and readable, with clear headings, tables, figure captions and mostly consistent references. Table 3 is clear. To strengthen within Accomplished, correct the [6] mismatch and add fuller source details; ensure every in-text citation matches the reference list and supports the specific claim.
